name: Samba Shares
description: Create and manage SMB shares for Windows, macOS and Linux clients: pick a folder, set who may read or write, and see the Samba service state. Share definitions are written by EthOS itself (the only process with the narrow sudoers rule for smb.conf), so this package ships the desktop app only.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.0: first release. The Samba Shares desktop app moves out of the core install; share configuration and the Samba service keep living in EthOS.
